spans.s:
Koṭihoma
(‘one crore oblations’)
------------------------------------------
For many centuries, the Hindus have believed that the स्तर्स् and प्लनेत्स् have a bearing on our life here and now. When they are not well-disposed, they can cause adverse effects. However, these adverse effects can definitely be minimised—if not eliminated—by the performance of some rites called ‘śāntis’.
Two such rites are the लक्षहोम and the कोटिहोम. They are generally performed by a king so that he and his kingdom are free from all calamities.
The कोटिहोम is to be done on an auspicious tithi (lunar day) in the śuklapakṣa (bright fortnight), associated with certain nakṣatras like रोहिणी, पुष्य and so on.
The fire-pit should be eight cubits in size.
Materials that can be offered are also specified in the works like the Bhaviṣyottarapurāṇa, along with many other details.
The number of ब्राह्मणस् who should offer the samit (fuel sticks) may range from 20 to 1000!
